title: All seven physical AC1018 SAT-v1 carriers to same-version DXF
scope: Project each of the seven bounded physical AC1018 3DSOLID SAT-v1 carriers in the selected source through same-version ASCII and Binary DXF, then prove exact decoded SAT text and selected entity metadata on fresh import.

source.producer_provenance: unverified; the publisher advertises a 3D pulley DWG sample

projection_scope: Each selected solid is exported alone with source symbol tables and block-record metadata; unrelated entities, layouts, and graph members are excluded.

implementation.behavior: Without a requested handle the selector picks the largest qualifying carrier; with a handle it requires exactly one matching carrier. Each run writes same-version AC1018 ASCII and Binary DXF, freshly imports each output, reverses the SAT-v1 text transform, and compares the normalized payload byte-for-byte. It also checks unique 3DSOLID readback, consistent nonzero output identity, layer preservation, EED field shape, and ownership-safe block projection construction.

validation.focused_result: PASS for all seven source handles 0x27–0x2d; each maps to output handle 0x40 and both ASCII/Binary fresh-import SAT payloads exactly match its normalized source payload (sizes 1,289–234,503 bytes)
validation.asan_run: for h in 0x27 0x28 0x29 0x2a 0x2b 0x2c 0x2d; do ASAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1 build-asan-custom/tests/libdxfrw_dwg2dxf_adapter_tests --modeler-ac1018-physical-sat-v1-projection /private/tmp/p7-trattocad-pulley.dwg $h; done
validation.asan_result: PASS for all seven source handles; address sanitizer reported no errors. LeakSanitizer is unsupported by this platform's runtime, so detect_leaks was not enabled.
validation.transaction_result: PASS: for all seven handles and both output encodings, incrementing the selected SAT range declaredByteSize is refused without changing the seeded destination; restoring the field and retrying with the same dx_iface exporter succeeds before exact readback.

nonclaims: The source producer is not independently authenticated.
Preserving the selected record's layer/EED metadata does not establish EED dependency closure or APPID semantics.
The seven records share one source and unauthenticated producer; this does not prove producer breadth, SAT topology, geometry semantics, native CAD acceptance, or whole-document closure.
The remaining 18 opaque records in the source are not included in these selected projections.
No DWG or DXF fixture was added to the repository.
